**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/475ba0b9e302a90911b69f09845cf2611509d17c884a619f9954c910c9a81e72.png] 

The centroid of a triangle divides the medians into segments in the ratio of 2:1, where the centroid is closer to the midpoint of the side (where the median intersects the side).

questions.question: What is the sum of all three digit numbers which are divisible by 20?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

We need to find the sum of all three-digit numbers that are divisible by 20.

**Formula Used:**

Sum = (n/2)(first term + last term)

**Calculation:**

 The first term (a) is 100, the last term (l) is 980, and the common difference (d) is 20.

The number of terms (n) can be calculated using the formula:

n = (l - a)/d + 1

n = (980 - 100)/20 + 1

n = 45

Now, we can calculate the sum of the arithmetic series:

Sum = (n/2)(a + l)

Sum = (45/2)(100 + 980)

Sum = 22.5 × 1080

Sum = 24300

**Therefore, the sum of all three-digit numbers divisible by 20 is 24,300.**

questions.question: Average weight of 10 persons is 40 kg. A new person join the group and average weight of 11 persons becomes 42 kg. What will be the weight of new person?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New Average = 42 kg, Old Average = 40 kg.

Increase in Average = 42 − 40 = 2 kg.

Total increase in weight for all 11 persons = 11 × 2 = 22 kg.

Weight of the new person = Old Average + Total Increase.

⇒ Weight = 40 + 22 = 62 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 62 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of 10 persons = 40 kg

Average weight of 11 persons (after new person joins) = 42 kg

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 Initial Total Weight (10 persons)
 
 400 kg
 
 New Total Weight (11 persons)
 
 400 kg
 
 
 + 62 kg

 
• 
 
 Total: 462 kg

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of initial 10 persons = 10 × 40 = 400 kg

⇒ Total weight of 11 persons = 11 × 42 = 462 kg

⇒ Weight of the new person = Total weight of 11 persons − Total weight of 10 persons

⇒ Weight of the new person = 462 − 400 = 62 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 62 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

When a Person Leaves the Group

Value of the person leaving = Old Average + (Net Decrease in Average × Remaining Persons) OR Old Average − (Net Increase in Average × Remaining Persons).

Replacement in Average

When a new person replaces an existing one: Weight of new person = Weight of replaced person + (Net Change in Average × Total Number of Persons).

Combined Average

If two groups of sizes n₁ and n₂ have averages A₁ and A₂ respectively, then their Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: In how much time will a sum of Rs. 12500 amounts to Rs. 20000 at the rate of 8 percent per annum at simple interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 12500

Final Amount (A) = Rs. 20000

Rate of interest (r) = 8% per annum

**Concept: **

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100. We rearrange this formula to solve for Time.

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest = Final Amount - Principal

⇒ Rs. 20000 - Rs. 12500 = Rs. 7500

Time = (Simple Interest × 100) / (Principal × Rate)

⇒ (7500 × 100) / (12500 × 8) = 7.5 years

**Hence, it will take 7.5 years for the sum to amount to Rs. 20000.**

questions.question: In a school there are total 414 students. The ratio of boys and girls is 5 ∶ 4. If 46 more boys gets admitted into the school, then what will be the new ratio of boys and girls?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 414

Ratio of boys to girls = 5:4

Number of boys admitted = 46

**Concept Used:**

The new ratio is determined by the increased number of boys and the unchanged number of girls.

**Calculation:**

Total parts = 5 + 4 = 9

Boys initially = 5/9 × 414 = 230

Girls = 414 - 230 = 184

New total boys = 230 + 46 = 276

New ratio of boys to girls = 276:184 = 92 × 3 : 92 × 2 = 3:2

**Hence, the new ratio of boys to girls is 3:2.**

questions.question: What is the total surface area of a cylinder having radius of base as 7 cm and height as 5 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 7 cm

Height (h) = 5 cm

**Concept: **

Total Surface Area of a cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

**Calculation:**

Total Surface Area = 2π × 7 × (5 + 7) = 2π × 7 × 12 = 528 cm²

**Hence, the total surface area of the cylinder is 528 cm².**

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is A. If next 5 even numbers are also included, then what is the average of these 10 numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is A

**Calculation:**

Let X is an even number.

So 5 five consecutive even numbers = X, X + 2, X + 4, X + 6 and X + 8

Avg = [5X + (2 + 4 + 6 + 8)] /5 = X + 4 = A

and if the next five even numbers X + 10, X + 12, X + 14, X + 16 and X + 18 are also included 

then Average will become = [10X + 2(1 + 2 + ... + 9)]/10

= (10X + 90) / 10 = X + 9 = A + 5

**Hence, A + 5 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If sin A=(6)/(7), then what is the value of sec A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin A = 6/7

**Concept:**

sin²A + cos²A = 1 and

sec A = 1/cos A

**Calculation:**

⇒ cos A = √(1 - sin² A)

⇒ √(1 - (6/7)²) = √(1 - 36/49)

⇒ √(13/49) = √(13)/7

⇒ sec A = 1/cos A = 7/√(13)

**Hence, the value of sec A is 7/√(13).**

questions.question:
The line chart given below shows production of sugar by two companies A and B in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b165f223542252e7aa539a8d6d7fae77f8d91d7f3af8ac04782655744793e689.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The production of sugar by A in years J and K together is 7.69 percent more the production of sugar by B in year L and M together.

II. The ratio of combined production of sugar by B in years M and N to the combined production of sugar by A in years K and L is 21 ∶ 16.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

I. The production of sugar by A in years J and K together is 7.69 percent **more** the production of sugar by B in year L and M together.

Production of sugar by A in years J and K together = 70 + 50 = 120

Production of sugar by B in year L and M together = 70 + 60 = 130

According to the question:

130 - 120 = 10

10/130 = 7.69%

The production of sugar by A in years J and K together is 7.69% **less** than the production of sugar by B in years L and M together.

Statement I is wrong.

II. The ratio of combined production of sugar by B in years M and N to the combined production of sugar by A in years K and L is 21 ∶ 16.

Production of sugar by B in years M and N = 60 + 45 = 105

Production of sugar by A in years K and L = 50 + 30 = 80

Ratio = 105 : 80 = 21 : 16

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A person goes to his office by scooter at the speed of 80 km/hr and reaches 60 minutes earlier. If he goes at the speed 50 km/hr, then he reaches 48 minutes late. What will be the speed of the scooter to reach on the usual time?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed1 = 80 km/hr

Speed2 = 50 km/hr

Time difference between the two cases = 60 mins early + 48 mins late = 108 mins = 108/60 hrs

**Concept:**

In the equation Time = Distance/Speed, the difference in the times traveled at the two speeds will give the usual time taken to reach the office.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the usual time be 'T' hours, and the distance be 'D' kilometers.

⇒ D/80 = T - 1

⇒ D/50 = T + 48/60

⇒ Subtracting these two equations we get,

⇒ D/50 - D/80 = 1 + 4/5

⇒ D = 80 × 3

⇒ D = 240 km

⇒ Usual time = D/T = 240/80 = T - 1

T = 4hr

Usual speed = 240/4 = 60km/hr

**Hence, the speed of the scooter to reach on the usual time is 60 km/hr.**

questions.question: P is 20 percent more than Q and Q is 30 percent less than R. If P is 420, then what is the value of R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P = 420

**Concept:**

Using the given percentages, we can determine the values of Q and R from P.

**Calculation:**

P = 120% of Q

⇒ P = 1.2Q

⇒ Q = P/1.2 = 420/1.2 = 350

⇒ Q = 0.7R

⇒ R = Q / 0.7 = 350/0.7 = 500

**Hence, the value of R is 500.**

questions.question: An article is sold for Rs. 1,260 after giving a discount of 40%. What is the marked priced of this article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 1,260

Discount = 40%

**Concept: **

The marked price (MP) is calculated by dividing the Selling Price by (1 - Discount/100).

**Calculation:**

⇒ MP = SP / (1 - Discount/100)

⇒ MP = 1260 / (1 - 40/100) = Rs. 2100

**Hence, the marked price of the article is Rs. 2100.**

questions.question: If (2 cos³ A - cos A) = (sin A - 2 sin³ A), then what is the value of A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **Substitution Method** by testing the given options in the equation.

Substitute **A = 45°**: we know sin 45° = 1/√2 and cos 45° = 1/√2.

LHS = 2(1/√2)³ − (1/√2) = 2/(2√2) − 1/√2 = 1/√2 − 1/√2 = 0.

RHS = (1/√2) − 2(1/√2)³ = 1/√2 − 2/(2√2) = 1/√2 − 1/√2 = 0.

Since LHS = RHS for **A = 45°**, it is the correct value.

**∴ The correct answer is 45°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (2 cos³ A − cos A) = (sin A − 2 sin³ A)

**Formula Used:** **cos 2A = 2 cos² A − 1** and **cos 2A = 1 − 2 sin² A**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0b35d5e124287d509dd89e8c5c463471f9e38969dff5786ad4f37ace80eb4f1.png] 

⇒ cos A(2 cos² A − 1) = sin A(1 − 2 sin² A)

⇒ cos A × cos 2A = sin A × cos 2A

⇒ cos A × cos 2A − sin A × cos 2A = 0

⇒ cos 2A (cos A − sin A) = 0

⇒ If cos 2A = 0, then 2A = 90° ⇒ **A = 45°**

⇒ If cos A − sin A = 0, then sin A = cos A ⇒ tan A = 1 ⇒ **A = 45°**

**∴ The correct answer is 45°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Double Angle Identities

cos 2A can be expressed as cos² A − sin² A, 2 cos² A − 1, or 1 − 2 sin² A.

Triple Angle Identities

sin 3A = 3 sin A − 4 sin³ A and cos 3A = 4 cos³ A − 3 cos A.

Trigonometric Ratios at 45°

For A = 45°, sin A = cos A = 1/√2, which makes tan A = 1 and cot A = 1.</p

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 20 days. A is 20 percent more efficient than B. B alone can complete the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B can complete the work in 20 days.

A is 20% more efficient than B.

Concept used:

Total Wok Done = Number of Days × Efficiency

Calculation:

The ratio of efficiency of A and B = 6 : 5

Let the efficiencies (work is done per day) of A, and B be 6x and 5x respectively.

Total Wok Done = Number of Days × Efficiency

⇒ 20 × (6x + 5x)

⇒ 20 × 11x

⇒ 220x

The time is taken by B alone to complete the work = 220x/5x

⇒ 44 days

∴ B can complete the whole work in 44 days.

questions.question: Angle subtended by a chord PQ on the centre of the circle is 140 degree. What will be the angle subtended by the chord PQ on the major arc of the circle?
questions.solution:
Given:

The angle subtended by a chord on the major arc of a circle is 140 degrees.

Concept used:

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e61016387a12a0b7724ae17abbfdfdb8c5011731a082ea6235147fd7a868da4.png] 

Let O, R, and PQ be the centre, a point on the major arc, and the aforementioned chord respectively.

So, the major arc for the PQ chord is PRQ.

Hence, ∠POQ = 140° 

Here, ∠POQ is the angle subtended by the same chord, PQ on the centre of the circle.

According to the concept,

∠POQ = 2 × ∠PRQ

⇒ ∠PRQ = 140°/2

⇒ ∠PRQ = 70°

**∴ the angle subtended by the chord AB on the major arc of the circle is 70°.**

questions.question: A woman buys a watch for Rs. 4,000 and sells it at a loss of 13%. What is the selling price of the watch?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 4,000

Loss = 13%

**Concept Used:**

The Selling Price (SP) is found by subtracting the loss from the Cost Price.

**Calculation:**

Loss amount = Loss/100 × CP = 13/100 × 4000 = Rs. 520

Selling Price = CP - Loss = 4000 - 520 = Rs. 3480

**Hence, the selling price of the watch is Rs. 3480.**
